name: Lava Walker
title: the Lava Walker
text: Your fire climbs to 4 and 5, and nothing reacts with it: every element fizzles on it, fuses too. It burns 5% a step standing, 3% crossing. You and allies beside you never burn on fire.

name: Island Maker
title: the Island Maker
text: Your fire's Overheats and eruptions reach 1 ring further (an Overheat ring of radius 2). You take 75% less damage from the reactions you set off, your own fire included.

name: Abyssal
title: the Abyssal
text: Free, once per turn, range 3: overcharge a dark 3 hex. It explodes as Pitch Black: 15% to every foe within 1, and +1 Rot each. The hex isn't consumed: it counts as dark 4 until your turn ends, then it's dark 3 again.

name: Hopekiller
title: the Hopekiller
text: Foes standing on your dark can't be healed or buffed: any heal they'd get hurts them for the same amount instead. A foe KO'd on your dark leaves dark 3 behind.

name: Judicator
title: the Judicator
text: Your light heals twice as much, and burns foes standing on it for that same amount.

name: Sunburst
title: the Sunburst
text: Free, once per turn, range 3: overcharge a light 3 hex. It explodes as a Solar Flare: 15% to every foe within 1, and allies within 1 heal 5%. The hex isn't consumed: it counts as light 4 until your turn ends, then it's light 3 again.

name: Leviathan
title: the Leviathan
text: Once a battle, ending your own walk on water 3 may submerge you, ending your turn. Next turn choose a form for the battle: Leviathos (double max and current HP, your blows splash foes next to the target) or Drowned (rooted; your basic attacks reach any foe on the board).

name: Being of Rain
title: the Being of Rain
text: Water costs you no move to cross. You never paint as you walk. When a walk ends, every hex you passed through and its neighbours gain water 1.

name: Superconductor
title: the Superconductor
text: Your explosions and reactions reach radius 2. If an action of yours sets off a reaction on your own hex, nothing from that action can hurt you. Also grants Self-detonate: free, once per turn, blow the charge or your fuse under you.

name: Overflow
title: the Overflowing
text: Every explosion or reaction you set off heals you 5% of your max HP (up to 20% an action). Healing past your max becomes a shield, up to 30% of your max HP, until hit.

name: El Niño
title: El Niño
text: Your wind areas reach 1 ring further: a wind skill's area of radius 1-3 grows by 1, and your gales spread 1 ring further.

name: La Niña
title: La Niña
text: At the start of your turn, every foe takes 2.5% of its max HP and is pulled 1 toward you.

name: Shatterer
title: the Shatterer
text: When your blow Shatters (a foe on glaze), the glaze on the hexes next to it shatters too: 8% to anyone on them, and your blow deals +15% for each hex shattered.

name: Sculptor
title: the Sculptor
text: Your ice landing on ice or glaze raises a pillar there (you may keep 6, not 4). You and your allies can climb onto your pillars as high ground. Your pillars shatter for double.
